study.title: Development and application of AI enabled automated drug delivery system for TACE guided by DSA

imaging.modality_detail: Intraoperative real-time 2D DSA fluoroscopic videos of drug injection during TACE; also rabbit and porcine DSA (NeuAngio 30F) for in vivo testing
imaging.territory_detail: Hepatic proper artery and branches (TACE for HCC); rabbit left renal and left gastric arteries in animal tests
imaging.frames_per_sequence: 15-18 frames per DSA video; videos 0.4-264 s; ~15 FPS internal/external 1, 11 FPS external 2

public_dataset_used.detail: ImageNet used only for pretraining; no public angiographic dataset

data_released.detail: DSA image data cannot be deposited publicly for privacy; de-identified clinical data on reasonable request

annotation.annotator_expertise: Two annotators with >3 years interventional surgery experience (Labelme); reviewed by two interventional radiology experts with 10 and 13 years of experience
annotation.inter_rater_value: Cohen's kappa used to assess inter-annotator consistency; value not stated in main text

task.task_description: Two-stage DL model: YOLO with local self-attention localizes the drug reflux region near the microcatheter tip, then a PA-FPN network segments refluxing drug droplets within the box; per-frame outputs drive a closed-loop automated injector (AI-FlowTACE) that adjusts flow rate.
task.clinical_application: Real-time reflux monitoring and closed-loop automated drug delivery during TACE for hepatocellular carcinoma, reducing nontarget embolization and operator radiation exposure

temporal_evidence.quote: five frames were evenly sampled as the feedback window to segment drug droplets within the reflux regions of each frame

evaluation.external_validation_detail: Two external cohorts (CMUSJSB, CMUSJNH) with different data sources and vendors; additional in vivo rabbit and porcine testing without fine-tuning

G5.quote: Another limitation is the inherent subjectivity in visually assessing reflux on 2D DSA images, despite using inter-observer consensus and Kappa coefficients.

G6.quote: applying its active control capability directly to human patients requires rigorous prospective clinical trials and strict ethics committee approval, which is beyond the scope of this preliminary translational study

G9.quote: This exclusion may introduce a certain degree of selection bias and may lead to overestimation of model performance.

G10.quote: The DSA image data reported in this study cannot be deposited in a public repository because they contain sensitive information that could compromise patient privacy.

other_limitations: Human clinical validation only indirect (retrospective simulation)
Performance uncertain under arteriosclerosis, hypotension or high-flow hemodynamics
Novel therapeutic agents may challenge continuous monitoring
Small operator validation sample (3 surgeons, 6 surgeries)
Need for manually controlled fail-safe mechanism
future_work: Phase I/II prospective multicenter RCTs versus manual TACE
Quantitative validation with in vitro phantom experiments
Low-power compact computational architecture for resource-limited settings
Update and optimize perception module for novel agents
